readme: Lore, roles and Milestone 1 scope per character. Art and animation data live in public/assets/assets.json. The concept is intentionally loose: agents fill gaps with their own design judgment and log non-obvious choices in docs/decisions.md. Anything marked mustNot is out of scope until a later milestone.

world.setting: A cosmic ocean under a living nebula, with a ruined archway and crystals on the shore. Fully fictional science fiction.
world.coreEvent: The capybara broke a fundamental rule of the universe. The cosmos is now correcting itself through several beings with different jobs.
world.tone: Playful, chaotic, a little ominous. Stylized, bloodless action.

milestone1.name: Cosmic Ocean Arena
milestone1.stopWhen: All six characters exist in the arena, the player pilots the Capybara waterbike, the Orca chases, the Snail changes tick rates, and npm run test:ci passes with 0 failures and 0 console warnings. When this is true, stop and write the handoff report. Do not start Milestone 2 ideas.

spawn.rule: Positions and counts come from the seeded PRNG so every run with the same seed is identical.

characters.title: Mad Scientist
characters.lore: Brilliant, reckless, and the reason everything is going wrong. Piloting a waterbike is the escape plan.
designHints: Rides a procedural waterbike because no bike art exists. See proceduralProps in assets.json.
Movement should feel like skimming water: momentum, drift, a visible wake.

must: Spawn on the water inside the play band.
Respond to the unified input actions: move in 2D within the band, jump, and one primary action of your choice.
Play idle, walk, swim and jump animations from assets.json at the right moments.
React to Orca contact with a visible and audible hit response.
may: Health or a simple shield meter
Defeat animation and a restart that reuses the same seed

characters.title: Warden of the Rule
characters.lore: Enforces the rule the capybara broke. Calm, methodical, relentless. The punisher.
designHints: Chase should feel inevitable but dodgeable: telegraph the lunge, then recover.

must: Spawn away from the player.
Chase the Capybara with a pursuit behavior that reacts to the player's movement.
Use swim while pursuing and jump for a telegraphed lunge.
Slow down or speed up when inside the Snail's time field.
may: Simple stagger after a missed lunge
Defeat animation if the player can win a clash

characters.title: Cosmic Avenger
characters.lore: Born from the damage the rule-breaking caused. Fast, angry, and leaves a trail of stardust.
designHints: The only art is a diagonal slide pose, so lean into slashing dashes along that diagonal.
Scale it down with renderScale, never edit the file.

must: Spawn in the arena and be visibly present.
Perform a simple repeating patrol or dash pattern that reads as a threat.
Use the swim and idle animations.

characters.title: Celestial Overlord
characters.lore: Sits at the top of the cosmic order and rules the others as a political authority. A ruler, not an object of reverence.
designHints: Large and imposing. Hovering in the sky or perched on the ruins both work.
Presence matters more than action in Milestone 1.

must: Spawn and be clearly the most imposing figure on screen.
Play idle continuously.
Trigger one small reaction when the player does something notable, such as a screen pulse or a look toward the player.
may: A single scripted jump to show off the jump art

characters.title: Steward of Time
characters.lore: Keeps the tempo of the universe. Slow on the outside, and everything around it feels it.
designHints: Its time field changes the simulation tick rate (a time scale applied to dt) for whatever is inside it.
The step size of the fixed timestep never changes. Only the scaled dt fed to entities does.
Make the field readable: a pulsing ring plus a pitch shift on the audio hum.

must: Spawn in the arena and drift slowly with the glide animation.
Maintain a visible time field.
Entities inside the field (including the Orca and the player) run at a different time scale than entities outside.
Expose the active time scale to the HUD or debug overlay so tests can assert it.
may: Toggle between slow and fast zones

characters.title: Non-sentient Pets
characters.lore: Drifting space-suited pets with no awareness of anything going on. Harmless and oblivious.
designHints: Use the two floating poses as a drift loop.
They are scenery with a little physics. Gentle bumps from the player are fine.

must: Spawn a seeded number of humans in the allowed range.
Drift with the walk animation and never block the player.
Respond to being bumped with a small nudge.
may: Occasional standing idle on the shore
mustNot: Harm to humans as a game mechanic
